method.payloadBytes: Core JSON only; signed MCP responses and transport envelopes are excluded.
method.comparison: Full canonical root model versus selected-child slice on matching restored snapshots. Intentionally different output scope.
method.timings: Synchronous Core model read and JSON.stringify measured separately; no construction, restore, GC, oracle, network, SDK, model inference, editor, or server time.
method.first: One first read per mode on a separate restored replica; process/JIT and OS are not cold. Order alternates by fixture.
method.warm: Same unchanged replica and same query after first read; mode order alternates each repetition. No untimed extra warmup.
method.heap: heapUsed changes from explicit pre-read GC to pre-final-GC and post-final-GC with result and JSON string live; not total allocation, peak RSS, or an allocation profiler.
method.counters: Instrumented public Doc.toJSON and projectVisibleBlock calls. Slice counts are API-reported; projectionMethodCalls may include nested work.
method.limits: Single-process local observations. Twenty-one warm samples by default; nearest-rank p95 is sample 20 after sorting. The first read is one observation per mode, subject to JIT and execution-order bias. Nested fixture has 1000 root siblings, not 100000. No global constant-time claim; first indexing can scan siblings. Stale paging correctness remains in Core tests.
